books_reviewed.book: Generative AI Professional Prompt Engineering Guide
Generative AI Prompt Engineering Learning Ecosystem

reading_evidence.note: Review uses verified public anchors recorded in the repository catalog.

item_reviews.title: When an agent says it is done, grade the database
item_reviews.reader_value: Connect conversational completion claims to durable-state verification, regression monitoring, explicit evaluation criteria and a reusable checking workflow.

item_reviews.title: Copilot code review becomes an API with adjustable effort
item_reviews.reader_value: API-triggered review is more dependable when review evidence is auditable, context is complete, the model is assigned a critic role and human-versus-agent responsibilities stay explicit.

item_reviews.title: Workspace turns prompts into images, mini-apps and cross-app work
item_reviews.reader_value: Cross-app work benefits from current-state data, structured handoffs, clear prompts and reusable editable artifacts that preserve intent.

item_reviews.title: AstaBrief opens a faster path to citation-grounded reports
item_reviews.reader_value: Citation-grounded reports improve when retrieval mixes semantic and exact matching, the research question is defined first, requests specify evidence needs and results feed an iterative learning workflow.

item_reviews.title: NVIDIA gives agents a verified DOCA skill set
item_reviews.reader_value: A reusable skill is a structured contract; these sections show why instructions, references, constraints and reusable templates must stay coherent.

item_reviews.title: Ambient agents wake on events and know when to ask a human
item_reviews.reader_value: Event-driven autonomy needs clear exception handling, escalation playbooks, clarification paths and role boundaries so a human can take over at the right point.
